model.name: Task 27.2: Class-unit dedup gated migration (one canonical Class per code class)
model.description: Collapse the 55 duplicate Class units (23 code classes, per audit) to ONE canonical each: repoint methods (dedup by name) + rewrite every UC.class/classes/method ref to the canonical + delete the emptied duplicates. Plus the by-construction invariant: wiring a UC to a Class REUSES the existing Class node, never mints a 2nd for the same code class. Removes the N-way chain fan-out over-count + restores single-source-per-class.
model.intention: PO/req 2026-07-01: prior chains minted a fresh Class per requirement -> the chain fans out through N duplicate Class nodes (over-count, broken single-source). One canonical per code class, enforced + cleaned up.

ALGORITHM (architect a3fcf1196): per code class N>1: pick canonical C (active-chain-first) -> move methods dedup-by-name (collapse same-name, keep active-chain/has-Impl, drop dup Method units) -> rewrite refs across ALL UseCase units (UC.class/classes[]/method: remap.has(x)?canonical:keep) -> delete emptied dup Class + dropped dup Method units AFTER refs rewritten. GATE = dry-run emits per-class count table {canonical, dupsRemoved, methodsMoved, nameCollisionsCollapsed, ucClassRefsRewritten, ucMethodRefsRewritten} + totals (163->108); --apply ONLY after the 5 HARD INVARIANTS (fail=ABORT): (1) NO METHOD LOST (distinct method-names per class BEFORE==AFTER on canonical); (2) NO NEW DANGLING — DELTA GATE (req ratification, verify_r27_2_migration.py baseline): the migration introduces ZERO NEW dangling UC.class/classes[]/method refs (BEFORE-dangling-count == AFTER, delta==0). model.acceptanceCriteria:
- [x] (invariant) The scenario graph holds AT MOST ONE Class unit per code class (by class name/identity); no per-req duplication
- [x] (reuse-on-wire) Wiring a UC to a Class REUSES the existing Class node for that code class (adds the method to it), NEVER mints a new Class unit (the R27.1 pattern)
- [x] (cleanup) The 55 existing duplicate Class units (23 code classes) are collapsed to one canonical each: methods repointed + every UC.class ref rewritten to the canonical + emptied duplicates removed
- [x] (gate) The canonical is the active-chain unit if one exists else most-methods; the collapse is dry-run + count FIRST (never silently drop a method or break a UC.class ref) + the 5 hard invariants pass before --apply
- [x] (invariant) After the fix, minting a chain for a NEW req on an EXISTING code class cannot create a duplicate Class unit (wiring reuses)
- [x] (verify) A trace audit shows exactly ONE Class unit per code class; no chain fans out through duplicate Class nodes + a CI check (1 Class unit per code-class name) so it never recurs
